title: Plan
$comment: v1.2. A proposed sequence of steps the user reviews, edits and approves (docs/api-contract.md: /plans).

revision.description: Bumped on every edit; approve and edit requests must send the revision they saw.

title.description: A short, general name for the tutorial, written by the planner: no account, organization, repository or other names from the request ("Create a private repository in an organization"). The workflow takes its title from it; null for older plans, which use the request.

mode.description: upfront: every step planned before the run (until v1.4). steps: an outline the user approves, then one decision per step during the run (ADR 0011). Absent means upfront.

outline.description: Step mode: the goal broken into rough ordered intentions, no selectors and no expected states. Null for upfront plans.

steps.description: Upfront plans: every step, at least one (the API checks it). Step-mode plans: empty; the steps are decided during the run.

PlanMode.title: PlanMode
PlanMode.description: How a task's steps are made (ADR 0011).

text.description: One rough intention, e.g. "Search for the place". Universal wording: no account or test names.

PlannedStep.title: PlannedStep
PlannedStep.description: One step before execution. The executed version (with observed state and verification) is Step in step.schema.json.
